title: Research Wiki

A shared notebook for hypotheses, experiments, and academic literature.

::: {#key-ideas .callout-note title="Key ideas"}
- The projects below study how agents collect learning samples and how they act on partial observations.
:::

## Research projects

- [Behavioral policy optimization: variations and open questions](behavioral-policy-optimization.qmd) ---
  active importance sampling for policy gradients, candidate extensions to
  Papini et al. (2024), and a plan for testing their costs and benefits.
- [Reinforcement learning under partial observability](pomdp-rl.qmd) ---
  how agents represent sensory input for decisions, and how learning a prior
  over those representations might guide attention.
